subject: ERP mapping & multi-PO invoice triggers for regional billing
messages:
From: Leah Kwan <leah.kwan@novagrid.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Contracts Ops <contracts@novagrid.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Redwood quote — PO and invoicing questions

Hi Sean / Ben,

Quick follow-up from procurement on our side. Our ERP requires either (A) a single master contract PO with separate invoice lines mapped to project codes per region, or (B) discrete PO numbers per billing milestone. We need to understand how Redwood will:

- Accept multiple PO numbers tied to one contract (if option B), and
- Populate an ERP code field on each invoice so our system can auto-apply cost centers, and
- Trigger invoices automatically when a milestone flag is set (we have automated milestone acceptance in our system).

Attached is an excerpt from our contract team showing the ERP fields they expect on the invoice (contract_terms_excerpt.pdf). Also flagging that finance will need net45 terms on the master invoice lines but they want the per-PO invoices to be dated to the milestone completion date.

Can Redwood support both approaches, and if so, what mapping template would you need from us? We have a go-live target 2026-09-15 and would like billing to be live on day one.

Thanks,
Leah Kwan
Sr. Procurement Manager — NovaGrid Energy
leah.kwan@novagrid.com

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Leah Kwan <leah.kwan@novagrid.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Contracts Ops <contracts@novagrid.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ERP mapping & multi-PO invoice triggers for regional billing

Leah — thanks for the clear summary. Short answer: yes, we can support both models, but there are trade-offs and a small operational setup step. Details below and a proposed next-step.

Option A (single master PO + invoice lines):
- We can accept a single contract PO and submit invoice line items with a custom "ERP Code" field per line. Your ERP will be able to ingest line-level codes for cost-center assignment.
- This keeps the number of documents lower; finance gets the master invoice with line-level dating tied to milestone delivery dates.

Option B (multiple PO numbers per contract):
- We can emit separate invoices per PO. Each invoice can carry the PO number and a header-level ERP code.
- This requires each PO to be entered into our billing system as a separate reference; if you have hundreds of POs we recommend option A for performance and reconciliation simplicity.

Operational requirements from Redwood:
- We will need a mapping spreadsheet that ties your PO/PO-line to our model/service codes and the ERP Code per invoice/line. I attached a small template (po-mapping-template.csv) — please populate PO number, PO line id (if applicable), ERP Code, milestone id, and desired invoice date rule.
- For automated milestone-triggered invoices we need a webhook-based confirmation from NovaGrid. When you mark a milestone accepted, your system should POST a small payload to our billing webhook (we'll provide the URL) containing PO number, milestone id, accepted_at timestamp, and acceptance document id (optional).

Net terms: we can apply net45 at invoice issuance. If you want the master invoice dated to contract signing but allow per-PO invoices to be net45 from milestone date, we can support that with separate invoice-level due dates.

If this sounds good I propose a 30-minute call tomorrow to walk procurement and finance through the mapping template and our webhook payloads. Proposed times: 2026-08-25 10:00 PDT or 15:00 PDT.

—Sean
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwood.ai

Leah — thanks again. We had a quick internal sync and here's the concrete proposal:  

1) Support model: Redwood will support both A and B. For scale and reconciliation we recommend A (master PO + line-level ERP codes) unless NovaGrid specifically requires separate PO docs per milestone.

2) Deliverables we need from NovaGrid by Aug 27:
   - Completed po-mapping-template.csv (PO #, PO line id, ERP Code, milestone id, desired invoice date rule)
   - Confirmation of webhook endpoint you will call to signal milestone acceptance (or we can provide a temporary test webhook if you prefer).

3) Temporary mitigation: If mapping spreadsheet isn't ready, Redwood will accept a single onboarding mapping job. We'll onboard the first 8 POs manually (one-time fee) and begin automated invoicing after your team hands off the spreadsheet. This will be shown as a PS line on the initial invoice and is standard for customers with complex ERP setups.

4) Next step: 30-minute sync to review the CSV and webhook payloads. Suggested window: Wed 2026-08-26 10:00 PDT. Please confirm and either attach the completed CSV or tell us who will own it on your side.

I'll attach the two files referenced for your procurement and finance teams (contract_terms_excerpt.pdf, po-mapping-template.csv).

Best,
Sean
